a.lede: The week, the Windows developer said it would offer buyouts to 60,000 workers as it looks to curb costs.
a.title: Microsoft profits soar days after announcing thousands of layoffs

b.lede: Microsoft is offering buyouts to around 60,000 members of its workforce as it looks to balance the books amid a ramp-up in AI data center spending.
b.title: 60,000 Microsoft employees offered voluntary buyouts as AI buildout costs bite
